title: group_and_receipt test: hard-coded port 19999 causes test flakiness
description: group_and_receipt.rs:651: carol_host = 127.0.0.1:19999 assumes this port is free. If another process binds it, outbox_tick may connect and deliver successfully, emptying the outbox row the test expects to remain. Fix: bind a TcpListener to :0, capture the assigned port, then drop the listener — the ephemeral port is freed but astronomically unlikely to be immediately rebound in loopback context.
